sub_scenario.one_line: library systems manager: decline the screen-heavy afternoon

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the migration ledger and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The systems calendar review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
An ordinary afternoon book club is no problem for me.
Do groups generally exhaust you?
No, when I have not been on overnight testing.
Someone new shadowed me in the library lab this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the cutover weeks into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
After catalog migration testing overnight, I signed the migration ledger at 10:40.
How much capacity remained?
I needed the afternoon away from bright screens and extended discussion.
I can attend a short librarian huddle after lunch.
Does that affect your eyes?
Not usually, because it is brief and not screen-heavy.
I archived last cycle's notes on the systems calendar and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
Overnight screens have aggravated my dry-eye condition and have begun disrupting my sleep.
What happens in long sessions?
My vision blurs and the fatigue becomes much stronger.
A vendor call about the migration ledger ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the library lab checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the cutover weeks.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the systems calendar records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
Optometry booked a Thursday 17:10 assessment to check the flare before next week's public cutover.
Can the assessment move?
No, the optometrist has no earlier opening before cutover.
I sketched next week's plan for the cutover weeks before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the migration ledger updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
I avoid late coffee because it makes the dry-eye medication and my sleep worse.
Could you use caffeine to attend?
No, it would compound the problem.
I compared two options for the systems calendar tooling and noted a mild preference.
Decision made?
Deferred until the trial ends.
I closed the week by updating the library lab handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
A team offsite is set for Thursday afternoon after migration testing and before my eye assessment. What should I do?
